description: This file defines the interface for Lua bindings related to a 3D vector type, including vector creation, printing, distance calculation, dot product, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, copying, and swizzling. It declares the vector structure, external dependencies, and function prototypes for vector operations.

methods.name: createVector
methods.description: Creates a new vector instance with specified components.

methods.name: lu5_vector_print
methods.description: Prints the vector, implementing a print method for Vector objects.

methods.name: lu5_vector_dist
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_dot
methods.description: Calculates the dot product of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_add
methods.description: Adds two vectors and returns the result.

methods.name: lu5_vector_div
methods.description: Divides one vector by another component-wise.

methods.name: lu5_vector_copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a vector.

methods.name: lu5_bind_vector
methods.description: Binds the vector type to the Lua state.

methods.name: lu5_vector_mut_idiv
methods.description: Mutably performs integer division on a vector.
